engines.language_notes: Default synthesis model is qwen3-tts-0.6b (nine named speakers). Override with KYBERION_SPEECH_CPP_TTS_MODEL; Irodori models need a reference voice via serve/CLI separately.
engines.notes: Local speech.cpp CLI via the managed tool-runtime (`pnpm tool:setup -- --tool speech_cpp --apply`). First use downloads the GGUF into the OS speech.cpp cache. Default voice ryan (en) / ono_anna (ja). Cross-platform alternative to the MLX Qwen3/Irodori Python bridges.
